status: WWB 14.02 layout audit fixes verified locally; corrective publication pending.

payloads.provenance: The pinned GitHub hen.bin does not match the patched MD5 printed in the upstream README; the exact bytes are retained and the discrepancy is disclosed.

integration: The authored WWB blue/XMB landing, two-panel HEN chooser, console status panel, options and cache controls are restored instead of the stock Afterglow landing.
The pinned upstream exploit modules, offsets, patchsets and HEN payloads remain byte-for-byte; no native payload was executed.
A one-use same-origin 14.02 guard still blocks direct or restored run-page execution.
The separate WWB BIN and ELF loader tools remain available from the restored landing and its verified offline closure.
The general PS4 offline pack excludes the 14.02 wrapper, short route and current runtime so it cannot preserve a stale handoff into the chooser's separate optional cache.
The previous 944d5aeed06f runtime, ready ZIPs and the 13.52/14.00 Afterglow integration remain preserved.
The guide and catalogue now describe the WWB chooser and optional cache instead of the retired stock landing.
The disabled automatic-cache status no longer guesses whether a saved copy exists.
The Options dialog now traps keyboard focus, exposes dialog semantics and keeps decorative HEN badges out of radio labels.

visualChecks: 1440 x 900 desktop: two 531px panels and no horizontal overflow
390 x 844 mobile: one 337px column, wrapped navigation and no horizontal overflow

limitations: Afterglow documents an unrecoverable kernel-allocation race, so an attempt can still freeze or power off a console.
The upstream-bundled hen.bin provenance discrepancy remains unresolved upstream.
Physical PS4 14.02 execution and cache persistence were not tested in this update.
